integrity: The conditional law is derived exactly from uniform surjections and finite multinomial moments. Exhaustive exact-rational enumeration over small sample and resample sizes is supplementary and does not replace the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The formulas condition on a fixed observed dataset and concern uniform resampling of labeled observations with replacement.
The support count is the number of represented original indices, so numerical ties do not merge sampling units.
The theorem does not cover studentization, nonlinear bootstrap statistics, weighted resampling, or unequal sampling probabilities.
An unindexed equivalent identity in older bootstrap or occupancy literature cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact support-conditioned variance of the nonparametric bootstrap mean
